messages:
Maria Chen: Pushed a PR for Dedicated capacity docs — migration how‑to + autoscale code examples and a short isolation note. Need a quick pass before I merge today. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/452
Sam Ortiz: On it. Quick Q: did you add the paragraph about eviction windows vs. preemption? Product asked we call out the 2-minute soft‑eviction signal.
Maria Chen: Yep, added a subsection under 'Isolation & Eviction' (3.2). I used 'soft eviction' and 'hard eviction' terms — open to wording tweaks.
Jess Patel: Skimmed — looks good overall. Two nits: broken link to SLA spreadsheet (old URL), and the terraform snippet in migration guide references an outdated provider block.
docs-bot: Linkcheck started for PR 452 — report available at https://deploy.redwood-inference.com/docs/pr/452/checks (will post results when done).
Kevin Nguyen: Also flag: the python SDK example for autoscaling uses `autoscale.configure(min_instances=2, max_instances=10)` but our SDK v0.8 expects `min_replicas`/`max_replicas`. Could cause copy/paste failures.
Maria Chen: Good catch, Kevin. I originally wrote that against the tooling branch. I'll update the snippet. Proposed replacement (in docs/examples/autoscale/python.md):
```python
from redwood import DedicatedClient
client = DedicatedClient()
policy = client.autoscale_policy.create(name="web-llm", min_replicas=2, max_replicas=10, target_latency_ms=200)
client.capacity.apply_policy(pool_id="pool-123", policy_id=policy.id)
```
Sam Ortiz: That looks correct. Also suggest adding a one‑line example for the JS SDK. Most customers copy that.
Maria Chen: Added a JS example and a short migration checklist for Terraform (not a full module, just the steps). Terraform snippet now points to `redwood/dedicated` v1.2 module and shows the `reserved_capacity` block.
Jess Patel: Re: SLA link — replace the old sheet with the canonical one: https://go.redwood.com/sla-matrix. Also can you add a tiny callout saying 'SLAs vary by commitment tier; see matrix for details'?
Emily Roth: Quick product ask: can we also mention recommended baseline sizing for small/medium/large pools? Even just a short sentence and link to infra-sizing guide would be helpful: https://go.redwood.com/infra-sizing.
Maria Chen: Added one sentence + link. Kept sizing high level to avoid making it prescriptive.
docs-bot: Preview build succeeded for PR 452. Linkcheck: 1 external link flagged (old SLA sheet). All other checks passed.
Kevin Nguyen: LGTM on code snippets. Minor suggestion: in the terraform example, change `gpu_count` to `gpus_per_node` to match the module args.
Maria Chen: Updated both fixes (SDK param names, terraform arg name, SLA link). Also clarified wording in eviction subsection: "soft eviction: kernel signal; graceful shutdown window ~120s" and "hard eviction: immediate preemption".
Sam Ortiz: Looks good to me. Approving — I'll merge after the final preview is up.
docs-bot: Final preview published: https://deploy.redwood-inference.com/docs/pr/452/preview.
Maria Chen: Merged at 1790001890 :tada: Thanks everyone for the quick reviews. I'll follow up if any users report migration friction.
